name: Giant Rotating Word
desc: One huge word extruded into pseudo-3D, slowly turning on its axis so the depth-shaded slabs sweep across a dark stage, letters jittering on the treble; slab, wireframe, chrome-iridescent, neon-tube, halftone or x-ray depth.

style.doc: rendering philosophy: modeled shaded slab / schematic outline-only 3D / iridescent metallic sweep / emissive glow tube / clipped-band halftone face / translucent additive x-ray stack

act.doc: dramaturgy: readable oscillating yaw / continuous full rotation / beat-snapped turn kicks
